liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Visions Of Johanna** (6 reviews): Reviewer calls Visions of Johanna exceptional and says it alone justifies downloading the show; Visions Of Johanna still brings the reviewer to tears years later [13][15][16][19][21][22]
- **It's All Too Much** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Set two opened with It's All Too Much, then a jam into Iko Iko, which felt electric; Reviewer sees the surprise pull of the Yellow Submarine song It's All Too Much as the show's strength [2][14][17][20]
- **Iko Iko** (4 reviews): At the end of Iko Iko, Bobby sang lower and lower through the bridge; Reviewer says Iko Iko felt like lifting the arena; Dick chose it for Jerry's Golden Gate Park memorial service [14][15][17][20]
- **Jam** (1 review): The jam coming out of Space sounded to the reviewer like Martian techno [17]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): The show started strongly with a fluid Hell In A Bucket and kept going [22]

## Setlist highlights

- **Disc01,Track01 Tuning**: rare: 7 archived performances [24]
- **Disc01,Track02 Hell In A Bucket**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [24]
- **Disc01,Track03 West LA fadeawy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **Disc01,Track04 El Paso**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **Disc01,Track05 Ramble On Rose**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [24]
- **Disc01,Track06 Tom Thumb Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **Disc01,Track07 Jack A-Roe**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **Disc01,Track08 Promised Land**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-03-18.142981.Boedicker.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 151 min [1]
- **gd1995-03-18.sbd.burke.95677.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 148 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Flaws: a cut in Drums, most of the encore break missing, and a dropout in Rain [2]
- **gd1995-03-18.nak300.bleich.92018.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 151 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [5]
- **gd95-03-18.sbd.1362.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 3.96/5 by 54 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the vocals are clearly understandable and the sound is great [18]
- **gd1995-03-18.sbd.ladner.32055.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 143 min [8]

## Around the show

- Reviewer stood twenty rows back on Jerry's side in set one, then watched set two from a private booth [14]
- Reviewer's second Philadelphia show and first with his brother; it hooked him at age seventeen [15]
- Weir played acoustic guitar on El Paso [1]
- The band paused after Hell In A Bucket while Jerry fixed a broken string [2]
- Garcia is below his former self but close to it here, making it a strong show by 1995 standards [13]
- In 1995 the other band members played tightly and on time, and Vince was growing into his role [16]
- Reviewer recalls the sound in the hall being somewhat better than the previous night [20]
- One of the 1995 nights that gave listeners hope for Jerry, by that year's standards [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-03-18.142981.Boedicker.flac1644**: taped by Dave Boedicker; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Source:Nakamichi 300 Mics W/CP4 Shotguns>Marantz PMD 430 Cassette Deck>Maxell XL-II-S Cassette Masters(1 90 Minute; Tape,1 100 Minute Tape)>Dolby "B" On>Sony… [1]. Also: A tape flip falls after Ramble On Rose; no music was lost before Tom Thumb Blues [1]
- **gd1995-03-18.sbd.burke.95677.flac16**: transferred by Tim Burke; source: SBD > ? [2]
- **gd1995-03-18.nak300.bleich.92018.flac16**: taped by John Bleich; transferred by Brian Green; source: Nak 300's > D6 > master Cassette [5]. Also: Transferred from John Bleich's Nak 300 masters; tape flips crossfaded, with EQ and plugins applied [5]
- **gd95-03-18.sbd.1362.sbeok.shnf**: source: "liberated" bootleg sbd cd > EAC > wav > shn [7]
- **gd1995-03-18.sbd.ladner.32055.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Chris Ladner; source: SHN Set ID 1362 (source: "liberated" sbd cd > EAC > wav > shn) [8]. Also: Original SHN converted to WAV, pops fixed, and the overlapping disc fade in Playin' restored seamlessly; Levels normalized and limited with a Waves plugin, then each set tracked and saved as FLAC [8]

## Art and photos
